description: Use this when you need to know whether a plant protection product (pesticide) registered in France can still be sold or used, and until which date. For 1 to 20 products (AMM number or trade name, optional crop filter): still authorised, still sellable, existing stocks still usable, and until when, use by use, from the official Anses E-Phy register (grace period, art. 46 Reg. 1107/2009). For farm suppliers, co-ops, advisers, growers, landscapers, traceability software. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

culture.description: Optional crop filter, French word as in E-Phy uses (e.g. Vigne, Blé, Pommier)

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.

produits.description: 1 to 20 AMM numbers or trade names, separated by commas or semicolons (a repeated name counts once), each at most 80 characters

name: phyto_lookup

donnees.description: E-Phy file used and its date

licence.description: Licence of the source data: nom, url, source, attribution (the credit the licence requires)

culture_filtree.description: Crop filter applied to this product's uses, as given in the request (blanks collapsed); null when no crop filter is given

derniere_fin_utilisation.description: Same rule, for the end of use of existing stocks

derniere_fin_vente.description: Latest published sale end among the uses still in their grace period; for a forbidden verdict, among the uses counted (past dates)

retrait_sans_delai_de_grace_publie.description: Withdrawn product with no end date published on any of its uses (whatever the crop filter). Treated as forbidden, but read the withdrawal decision: the absence of a published date does not prove there is no grace period

dates_publiees.description: Present only when the published end of sale is later than the published end of use: the earlier date applies to both, fin_vente returns it, and this object keeps the dates as published

verdict.description: Best status across the uses considered

title: Sentinelle phyto: phyto lookup
